research.text: Stephanie Wang joined the faculty of the Paul G. Allen School of Computer Science & Engineering at the University of Washington in fall 2024. Her research is primarily in distributed systems. She is especially interested in how we can build intermediate abstractions that make it easier to build high-performance, fault-tolerant, and domain-specific systems. Along those lines, she is interested in domains where large-scale application development is still pretty hard, such as machine learning and data processing. She’s also interested in programming languages as the interface that can improve distributed systems.
